spans.text: On the deck of the cruise.
Boom!
All threats have been eliminated!
Under the Dolls' coordinated attack, the heavy warframe is paralyzed.
This can't be happening!
This "Supernova Warframe", worth 600 million, is no match for scrap metal like you?!
A heavy mech, no matter how impressive, is little more than a lumbering target when piloted by an amateur.
So this is all there is to the power you're so proud of, Mr. Smuggler.
How...How could this be...?!
Ah, good... The mech isn't a complete write-off yet.
Can't believe you've pushed me this far...
That woman must still be on the ship... Haha, very well! Very well!
Valentin laughs maniacally as he takes out a device that looks like a remote control.
Meanwhile, the Supernova Warframe's defense system is also activated.
A remote control? Don't tell me there's a bomb...!
This is what you get for being in my way! You can repent on the seabed!
O-Oh no!
Before the Dolls can stop him, Valentin has already pushed the detonation button...
The mech is also ready to take off...
...What?
The expected explosion never takes place...
The Supernova Warframe hasn't taken off either.
Utterly confused, Valentin pushes the button repeatedly as the silence drags on.
No way! I've prepared enough explosives to sink four ships...!
It's over.
Valentin tries to move the mech, but it refuses to budge.
...How unsightly, Mr. Valentin.
...Eric, you...
I thought we had an agreement!
Paula Snow gives the case in her hand a little shake.
Mr. Valentin, I'm not stupid enough to take you at your word...
Besides, working with an arms dealer...really isn't the best idea.
...Y-You've been planning to double-cross me right off the bat!
You bitch!!!
Hey, this whole sham of inviting me to this charity ball is also pretty dumb.
Though they've actually brought along the Mermaid's Heart, which costs an absolute fortune on the black market...
I checked⁠—it's genuine~ Still, being the sleazy brute that you are, you kept both the money and the goods, and even killed your client.
You can hardly blame me for not trusting you, can you?
You sabotaged the explosives and my mech?
Eh, it did take some effort. But it's game over for you, Mr. Valentin~
Miss Lewis over there, make sure you aim properly. You'll frighten if you keep pointing that gun at me.
Lewis has raised her weapon the moment she saw Paula Snow.
However, after a moment of hesitation, she aims for Valentin instead.
...Can we have an explanation?
What is there to explain?
This woman is clearly colluding with the smuggler and she had us running around like headless chickens!
You need to be more careful with your words, Miss MDR.
I was only "pretending" to work with him.
Valentin is about to say something when Welrod walks up to him and digs her muzzle into his side.
A criminal caught red-handed should save their confession for the police.
...Jeanie isn't a villain, and neither are you.
Alright, Mr. Valentin did invite me onboard to participate in a double-cross deal that involves killing the client and taking the money and the goods.
But it should be pretty obvious by now that I've given up on the deal.
We didn't just "win" the tickets, did we?
...Pfft, obviously not.
You were chosen.
There are so many people in your fan club, you must've gone to a lot of trouble to pick me.
Not at all, all members leave an automatic record when you register.
I just had to filter the members and make a shortlist~
So that's the Mermaid's Heart inside the case?
The one and only. Fancy a look?
I'm not interested.
But...you're not planning to keep it for yourself, are you?
Paula Snow lowers her voice and whispers to Lewis conspiratorially...
My dear Miss Lewis.
Who do you think it should belong to?
...Its original owner.
And who might that be?
The artisan who created it? The millionaire who bought it? Or...the gangster who seized it by force?
It has been drenched in blood from the moment it was created, and it gets bloodier still every time it changes hands.
This priceless treasure is actually worthless.
Unlike moonlight, it does not illuminate the dark; unlike air, it does not bring life.
It's just a lifeless object, but having been given a fairy tale name, it becomes a symbol of love. Isn't that laughable?
So...who do you think it belongs to?
It belongs to itself.
...That's a line from your very first movie. But...
Hush~
I've had my eyes on you from the moment you embarked on this journey.
It's been a pleasure to have you along this ride.
But the war is over.
What?
The war is over.
And I'm not going back.
Farewell. Just as the spring breeze will return, I hope we'll meet again some day.
Wait, Jeanie! No, Paula!
The police foiled a major arms smuggling operation on board the cruise ship Aegean and arrested Valentin, leader of the international smuggling syndicate.

Using false identities, Valentin has been supplying weapons to rebel forces on the periphery of the White Zone in the last two years and is indirectly responsible for a large number of civilian casualties.
This smuggling operation was foiled with the help of several Griffin Tactical Dolls, who are passengers on the ship. Over 900 weapons have been seized, worth around 6.7 million.
On the deck.
This dessert is a special treat from the staff. Please enjoy.
Thanks. Please give us five more of the vanilla ice cream we just had.
Uh... S-Sure!
No, make that six, please. M950A asked me to eat one on her behalf.
Can your body handle that much ice cream?
Who cares~
Say, did Paula Snow just take the gemstone? The Mermaid's Heart, huh... That's some legendary treasure!
She couldn't have risked everything just to keep it for herself, right?
So what did she tell you back then, Lewis?
Heh, it's our little secret!
She wouldn't say no matter how many times MDR asked.
She must've bewitched her!
Oh, please! Even if I told you... Humph, you know what? I'm not telling~
In any case, she's not a bad person at all!
Beautiful people can do no wrong in your eyes.
That's not true! I don't judge people by their appearance!
...That isn't convincing at all coming from you.
Huh? Guys, look at this.
M200 points at a news article posted on Grifchan.
It's all the way at the bottom of the news page, which shows how insignificant this report is.
At first glance, it looks like just another news story of an orphanage receiving a donation.
The sum was enormous... The orphanage wanted to build a new wing and name it after the benefactor...
But they wished to remain anonymous...
Do you think that was Paula Snow?
Who knows?
The timing checks out.
Hehehehe...
Hey, what are you giggling about?
The Commander just sent me a message to tell me that I did a good job and even promised me a reward...
The Commander is also giving you a reward?! You're damn lucky!
Well, it wasn't just pure luck...
Still, at least it's over.
Yeah, even our vacation is over.
Now that's not true. Our vacation is NOT over!
That's right.
Heheh, I can't believe the captain has given us permission to enjoy all facilities and services on board free of charge!
Everything we've done was all worth it~!
It's all thanks to Lady Paula~
(Sighs) I wonder when I'll ever see her again.
Ha! If we ever run into her again, it'll probably be another crazy adventure.
Now forget about that and let's go! Let's play some water polo!
Oh, I'm coming!
Lewis puts down her console and starts enjoying her vacation in earnest.
On the screen, the movie is still playing...
Lamenting our inability to take destiny into our own hands, we shed tears in the agony of endless waiting.
I would rather take up arms and fight by your side.
Farewell. Just as the spring breeze will return, I hope we'll meet again some day.
The Wave Wrangler 【END】
